violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fans in all walk-in coolers need to be deep cleaned.

Laundering of linens. — --Laundry equipment was not located in area separated from exposed food or from exposed clean equipment/utensil. - Clean towels found on top of raw meats in meat dept walk-in cooler
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. - 3 comp sink in deli dept is leaking, needs repair.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. - No hand soap found in meat dept hand wash station.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Ceiling in deli needs repair. - Floor in deli needs repair, wood is cut, uncleanable. - Floors in meat dept and produce in need of deep clean and resealed. - Wall behind 3 comp sink in deli needs repair, discolored, dry wall showing - Ceiling in deli walk-in cooler is leaking.
Lighting. — --Light intensity for walk-in refrigeration or food storage area was insufficient. - Meat dept ceiling is leaking and has ruined the lights making it insufficient.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fans in all walk-in coolers, meat dept, produce dept need to be cleaned.
